children: Enphase Energy reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $293.33 million, down 28.5% from the prior-year quarter, while net income fell 64.9% to $23.39 million and diluted EPS declined to $0.17. Lower battery and microinverter shipments weighed on revenue amid weaker U.S. residential demand.
¹ Reported as “Net revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per share”.
Enphase began shipping IQ9S-3P commercial microinverters and launched IQ9N residential microinverters in the U.S. and key international markets.
The IQ Battery 10C is shipping in the U.S., and expanded compatibility allows homeowners to add Enphase storage to existing third-party solar systems.
Europe remains challenging, with constrained demand expected in the fourth quarter of 2026. Safe-harbor agreements are becoming a more important U.S. sales channel.
Enphase is developing a 1.25-megawatt solid-state transformer for data centers, with customer pilots targeted for 2027 and commercial shipments planned for 2028.
